title: The Words — Sc057: the hallway dance — whole class advances on camera (198 frames)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: How to shoot a group dance number as a single advancing wide shot. One photographic corridor plate never changes; the entire class is layered - six finished puppets on named layers (Tobias's comp alone is an 805-kf nest of 7 puppets; Darwin's head comps run 566 kf) and seven white placeholder characters on '3d character ref' layers for the classmates other departments finish - and the whole ensemble scales/moves toward camera for 198 frames so a static background feels like a tracking shot. Two per-character mask layers keep the advancing dancers correctly occluded by the corridor. The mixed cast is the point: finished Flash puppets and unfinished white references share one choreography, timed together in one file, because the dance only works if every department hits the same beats.
notes: The episode's dance number in wide shot: the ensemble starts as a distant cluster at the far end of the corridor (frame 1 shows only a tiny angry Darwin at the right-hand lockers) and dances toward camera for the full 198 frames, growing continuously until the cast fills the foreground at frame 198 - Darwin front and centre throughout (grin pose f99, leg-up f124, crouch-shout f149, wide squat f173, backview bend to close f198).

Seven layers under a '3d character ref' folder place placeholder items c2, c3, c5, c6, c7, c9, c10 (7 keyframes each): in the render these are the WHITE unfinished classmates - a huge T-Rex holding a balloon, a winged eyeball, a small toast figure and others - the mixed-media characters carried in this file only as white reference versions for other departments to finish.

The six finished Flash dancers each get a named layer (tobias, carmen, masami, ocho, carrie with 10 scene keyframes, plus Darwin on 'Layer 2' as a Duplicate Items Folder copy of his puppet), and two scene-level mask layers solve occlusion as the group advances past the corridor pillars.
This scene's Darwin dance choreography is already extracted in production/dance-choreo; this entry documents the full scene anatomy around it.
